title: ATTN.------DYM.FT.
description: Second diagram on page 53 (BK(NM)-29), paired with (R)INDIV-TD × SOC-RT above. Where the first diagram structurally diagrams the cosmic-postulation route through which individual-transformation reaches the reality of attention, this one picks up exactly ATTN as subject-axis and crosses it with dynamic-functionalism: ATTN (attention — the form's actual receiving attention) crossed with DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism — the partner-axis's working dynamic-functioning). ATTN sits on the right with the subject-arrow; DYM-FT sits at upper-right as partner-axis. EXP-INFO-B (exposure-information base) sits at top-center and AFI (affinity insight) at upper-right with AF-TD (affinity transformation-dynamics) further right as the partner-side upper outputs. CULT-O (cultural other) sits centrally right of ATTN; SPT-GH (spirit-ghost) below AFI; AGT (agent) at the upper-left and C-INFO (central information) below as the subject-side leftward outputs. APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) sits centrally as the bridging hub with POL-P (political particulars) below. AFTF (after-the-fact) anchors the left, with PART (participation) at bottom-center and EXPM (exposure-method) at the bottom as the bridging-axis downward chain. Structural argument: when attention is crossed with dynamic-functionalism, the upper diagonal EXP-INFO-B → AFI → AF-TD is the *attention-to-functionalism conversion route* — exposure-information base routes through affinity-insight into affinity-transformation-dynamics on the partner-side. SPT-GH below AFI shows where the partner-axis can route attention into spirit-ghost (Braxton's recurring term for the form's vibrational residual). CULT-O routes ATTN through the cultural-other into the partner-side. APP-RDEF → POL-P is the bridging hub: applied-redefinitions hold political-particulars at the central downward output. The subject's AGT → C-INFO → AFTF → PART → EXPM chain on the left is what attention produces when routed back through agent and central-information into after-the-fact participation and exposure-method. The structural argument: the prose's 'looking at the heart of creativity' is structurally the EXP-INFO-B → AFI → AF-TD upper diagonal *and* the APP-RDEF central hub both holding open simultaneously — without both, attention produces only the AFTF → PART exposure chain on the subject side, never reaching the partner's affinity-transformation-dynamics.
